facts.fact: The World Bank brief states a new Digital Economy Policy prepared by the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation completed a series of public consultations in November 2022 and is at the final stage of approval; the brief gives no date for that status, so its March 2023 publication date is used.

The World Bank brief states an implementation plan/strategy associated with the Digital Economy Policy will be prepared once the policy is approved, so none existed at its March 2023 publication date.

systems.tiers: National; consultations completed November 2022; at final stage of approval in March 2023; the brief ties it to whole-of-government gaps in shared platforms, data centres and digital signature
Public sector: national interoperability standard, new shared services and platforms
